question: Which traffic signal has the highest mean actual/free-flow traversal time ratio on its incoming edges? For each vehicle-edge traversal on a TLS incoming edge, compute ratio = (last_seen_time - first_seen_time) / (edge_length / edge_speed_limit). Skip traversals with actual <= 0. Average all ratios per TLS and find the worst. Answer format: <tls_id>
